groups.name: Booba
groups.profile: Data-theft brand (posts as “Booba Project” on Ransomware.live, “Booba Team” on RansomLook); little public TTP reporting. Lists sector, website and stolen-data size per victim; today’s batch was mostly small U.S. public-sector and healthcare bodies.

groups.name: Inception
groups.profile: RedPacket flags its listings as possibly unverified or fabricated — treat as low-confidence.

groups.name: Vortex
groups.profile: RedPacket notes reports of unverified or fabricated Vortex claims.

groups.name: Aoqin
groups.profile: “AOQIN Leaks”, tracked since 4 Nov 2026; posts revenue, staff counts, data types and publication countdowns with “not paid” status.

groups.name: Climax
groups.profile: Little-documented leak site; posts only sector and website, no samples or volumes.

groups.name: Rhysida
groups.profile: RaaS active since May 2023 (CISA AA23-319A); auctions data; detailed inventories of stolen bookkeeping and mailboxes in today’s posts.

groups.name: The Gentlemen
groups.profile: Emerged 2025; high-volume poster, reported to abuse Group Policy for deployment. Ransomware.live re-listed 16 of its victims today that №83/№86 had already covered (reposts).

groups.name: Akira
groups.profile: Active since March 2023 (CISA AA24-109A); double extortion with Windows/ESXi encryptors; frequent abuse of VPNs without MFA.

groups.name: Aurora
groups.profile: Little-documented leak site; posts long corporate profiles with registry details.

groups.name: Black X
groups.profile: Little-documented actor focused on Iranian organisations; claims multi-TB thefts with file-map proof.

groups.name: Curious Worm
groups.profile: New leak site first seen 11 Nov 2026; U.S. healthcare-heavy; posts masked domains as “pending”, then reveals them.

groups.name: EndZone
groups.profile: Little-documented; today’s post claims both encryption and exfiltration and says it left patient-call systems running.

groups.name: Helix
groups.profile: Little-documented; claims publication via GoFile archive tiers.

groups.name: INC Ransom
groups.profile: Prolific RaaS since mid-2023 (MITRE G1032); edge-device exploits and spear-phishing; global victim set.

groups.name: N0n
groups.profile: Data-sale/extortion site tracked since Sep 2026; often posts anonymously (“Company #N”) then names victims; Ransomware.live maps it to Valid Accounts (T1078).

groups.name: Netrunner
groups.profile: Little-documented leak site; brief company profiles only.

groups.name: Panzer
groups.profile: Leak site tracked since Aug 2026, focus on Indonesian and Malaysian public-sector and consumer brands.

groups.name: Payload
groups.profile: Little-documented leak site; company-profile listings, mostly European mid-market.
